message.subject: Last chance: A new approach to data modeling
message.html:
Explore how AI and governance are reshaping modeling workflows.

Having Trouble? View Online
May 21, 2026
11:00 AM ET
Register Now →
Hi, Jishnu


Modern data modeling teams are changing the way they work. AI‑assisted, browser‑native tools are reshaping the modeling lifecycle, while governance still matters more than ever as organizations prepare their data foundations for AI.

In this session, data modeling experts join Quest Software for a candid conversation on how today’s teams are approaching modern data modeling.

You’ll learn:

  • How data modeling is shifting from static documentation to living, governed systems
  • When to use on-prem vs. cloud-native data modeling
  • Why a hybrid approach is becoming the practical answer
  • How AI and real-time collaboration are reshaping workflows 

You’ll also get a first look at Quest Data Modeler, a new cloud-native, AI-assisted modeling solution built into the Quest Trusted Data Management Platform.
